cohort: Women undergoing operative vaginal delivery (forceps or vacuum-assisted births) with proper indications and informed consent were included.
finding: Forceps-assisted deliveries were associated with significantly higher maternal morbidities such as perineal tears, PPH, and cervical tears compared to vacuum-assisted deliveries, with largely comparable neonatal outcomes except for higher SNCU admissions in the forceps group.
mod_finding: Forceps-assisted deliveries were associated with significantly more maternal trauma (perineal tears, PPH, cervical tears) and higher neonatal SNCU admissions compared to vacuum-assisted deliveries.
